reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: low-temperature aging of AlCoCrFeNi2.1 to precipitate coherent L12 in the FCC phase is well-supported by literature on similar eutectic high-entropy alloys, and the proposed Orowan strengthening and microstructural stabilization mechanisms are appropriate for the stated property improvements.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with explicit falsification criteria (10% yield strength improvement, measurable creep rate reduction, absence of over-aging), though the corrosion test details are slightly vague.
reasons.usefulness: This is a highly useful, directly actionable hypothesis for the stated industrial problem, offering a simple heat treatment with clear mechanisms and a well-defined testing protocol that addresses all required performance aspects.
